SettingsDrawer.queuesIntro: Pausing a queue only stops it from picking up new videos — whatever that stage is already processing finishes normally. Handy for giving yourself time to switch LLMs without a video getting half-processed on the old model.
SettingsDrawer.emailSenderNote: The sender address and its app password stay fixed in .env for security — only the recipient is editable here.
